title: Waffle Client SMP
description: The SMP Experience using Waffle Client
body:
## Introduction
Enjoy Waffle Clients' Performance and want more well you're in luck! Waffle Client SMP is a version of Waffle Client that matches its performance while giving SMP-Based QoL. This version includes: Minimaps, World Maps, More Texture packs & Shaders and much more.

for the original modpack click [here](https://modrinth.com/modpack/waffle-client)

[ THIS VERSION INCLUDES ESSENTIAL MOD UNLIKE THE ORIGINAL ]
